ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The diagram represents the life cycle of an insect. From the egg to the adult, what is the order of the labeled stages shown in the diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the picture there are three boxes representing insect life cycle stages. The lower right box is labeled B, and inside it is an egg-shaped object; the lower left box is labeled C, and inside it is a small larva/nymph-like insect; the upper box is labeled A, and inside it is a larger adult. The arrows show lower right B pointing to lower left C, and lower left C then pointing to upper A. Reasoning: The question asks for the order from egg to adult. The egg is B, then the arrow goes to C, and finally the arrow goes to adult A, so the order is B-C-A.
